channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Trump’s call to ‘nationalize’ elections has Republicans and Democrats talking
item.description: The president’s comments terrified Democrats concerned about backsliding and didn’t sit well with Republicans worried about states’ rights.

item.title: Meet Puppy Bowl MVPs before the big game — and help local shelter pets
item.description: Before “Leo” and “Remy” trot onto the field Sunday for Puppy Bowl XXIII, San Diegans can get a sneak peek at the furry MVPs — and do some good — on Saturday.

item.title: Opinion: Lawsuits push back on Trump’s attack on child care
item.description: Unions, small businesses and states are suing to stop the administration from punishing blue states by withholding $10 billion in funding.

item.title: Driver arrested after allegedly running over police bike
item.description: A driver has been arrested on suspicion of DUI and vandalism after he allegedly ran over a San Diego Police Department bicycle during a downtown traffic stop, authorities said Saturday.

item.title: Wow! Mega Millions jackpot reaches $366M after Friday night drawing
item.description: No tickets matched all six numbers in the latest multi-state Mega Millions drawing, sending the estimated jackpot climbing to $366 million.

item.title: Plane lands safely on highway in Lakeside
item.description: Three people escaped injury Saturday when the single- engine private plane they were flying in landed on a highway in Lakeside, according to the California Highway Patrol.

item.title: Beyond the French Quarter: San Diego revs up for Mardi Gras
item.description: Mardi Gras is always held the day before Lent, when observers attempt to abstain for 40 days from some of their biggest temptations.

item.title: Is a superbloom coming? Why San Diego’s desert wildflowers won’t be rushed
item.description: After a wetter-than-usual winter and early bursts of color across Anza-Borrego Desert State Park, a familiar question is blooming right alongside the wildflowers: Is San Diego County headed for a full-blown superbloom?

item.title: Early ending to voucher program puts hundreds of San Diegans at risk of homelessness
item.description: One recipient said, “A lot of people are gonna be homeless, and a lot of families, and it's gonna break families apart … I see it already.”

item.title: Ring legend Pacquiao part of San Diego expansion club in new boxing league
item.description: A new agreement with the Team Boxing League explores the involvement of Pacquiao with the league as an owner and active competitor.
